observations: Photo 0: standing gas cooker, lid up (reflective panel), 2 gas burners + 1 large and 1 small electric hotplate visible, front panel has several knob positions but most are empty or have bare stems, only one or two knobs fitted.

Photo 1: same cooker with 2 of the 4 gas burners lit (blue flame), glass lid propped open, tiles behind are marble-pattern (different wall than photo 0, suggesting different location/angle or edited background).

Photo 2: wider view showing full standing unit with oven compartment below, glass oven door, a row of 8 control knob positions on the front fascia but only 2 knobs actually present (rest are bare metal stems or empty holes), floor is dark tiled, window light visible.
No brand name, logo or model plate is legible in any photo.
No photo shows the oven interior, the electric hotplates in operation, the receipt, or the warranty card.

identity.kind: standing gas cooker with 4 gas burners and 2 electric hotplates, oven below

claims.claim: 4 gas cooker and 2 burner making 6 burner in total
claims.evidence: Photo 0/2 show 4 gas rings and 2 electric hotplates consistent with the count, but only 2 gas burners are shown actually lit (photo 1); the electric plates are never shown powered on.
Photo 2 shows the control panel missing most of its knobs (only 2 of roughly 8 positions have knobs fitted), which is itself a fault and casts doubt on whether all burners can even be controlled.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: No purchase date, receipt, or low-usage indicator visible in any photo; cooker shows visible wear (scuffed panel, missing knobs, worn edges in photo 2).

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened
claims.evidence: Missing control knobs visible in photo 2 are a visible fault; 'motor never opened' cannot be checked from photos regardless.
No receipt or warranty card is shown in any of the 3 photos.

risks.risk: Missing knobs may mean some burners cannot be ignited/controlled without pliers or replacement knobs, lowering functional burner count below the claimed 6.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the full control panel with all knob positions, plus a video of each burner being turned on individually.
risks.if_unproven: priced as only the 2 confirmed-lit gas burners working, rest treated as non-functional

risks.risk: Electric hotplates (the 2 round elements) may not heat at all; only gas burners were demonstrated lit.
risks.proof: Video showing the electric plates glowing/heating when switched on.
risks.if_unproven: priced as electric plates not working

risks.risk: Oven function and interior condition unknown (rust, broken heating element, broken door seal).
risks.proof: Photo/video of oven interior and a demonstration of oven heating.

risks.risk: Gas safety (leaks, worn hose connections, regulator condition) not visible.
risks.proof: Close-up of gas inlet/hose/regulator and a leak test clip.

risks.risk: Claimed receipt/warranty cannot be confirmed to belong to this exact unit.
risks.proof: Photo of receipt/warranty card with matching serial or model visible.

proof_requests: Video showing every one of the 4 gas burners and both electric hotplates switched on simultaneously.
Clear close-up of the full control panel showing all knobs present and functional.
Photo of the oven interior and a short clip of it heating.
Photo of the receipt and warranty card with legible date and item match.
Close-up of the gas hose/regulator connection for leak/safety assessment.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a standing gas cooker with 4 gas burners and 2 electric hotplates, but visible missing knobs and unverified electric/oven function mean it must be priced at worst case as a used standing cooker with functional defects, comparable to the lower-priced generic used standing cookers rather than the higher branded or fully-demonstrated ones.
